title: Fabry Disease and the Effectiveness of Enzyme Replacement Therapy (ERT) in Left Ventricular Hypertrophy (LVH) Improvement: A Review and Meta-Analysis.

answer.design_quote: We performed a meta-analysis to analyze all these studies for the results of LVMI in FD patients with or without ERT (5 clinical cohort studies and two RCTs) and before ERT or 4 years after ERT (3 clinical cohort studies and one RCT).
answer.k_quote: Ultimately, we analyzed five clinical cohort studies and two RCTs via a pooled analysis of proportions
